description.text: Introduction: Dentistry education of China Medical University was started in 1948. In 1979, dentistry program was established and the dentistry department was founded in 1985. Then in 1988, it developed into the School of Dentistry and Oral Health. The dentistry program of CMU is the first-level characteristic discipline of Liaoning province, the pilot program of college comprehensive reform of Liaoning province. The Stomatology Teaching Center is the model center of Liaoning provincial experimental teaching as well as the clinical skills training center for the college students in Liaoning province. Periodontics and oral and maxillofacial surgery are the key clinical specialized subject construction projects of national Health Development Planning Commission. It passed the stomatology accreditation organized by Ministry of Education on December, 2014 and ranked No. 9 in the evaluation of Ministry of Education on colleges’ stomatology program in the whole country on 2022.Main Courses: Basic Medicine, Basic Science of Stomatology, Clinical Science of Stomatology, Human Anatomy, Histology and Embryology, , Diseases of the Oral Mucosa, Oral and Maxillofacial Diagnostic Imaging, Pathophysiology, Periodontology, Pediatric Dentistry, Oral and Maxillofacial Surgery, Prosthetic Dentistry, OrthodonticsGraduation and Degree Issued: Students who has completed all the required courses and passed all the examinations will be allowed to graduate. Students who meet the requirement of Degree Awarding Committee will be awarded the degree of Bachelor of Dental Surgery. Fee Structure Tuition Fee: RMB 40000Physical examination: 700RMB;Residence permit: 800RMB per year;Medical insurance: 800RMB per year;Books: around 3,000RMB for the first year (CMU will return the extra or charge more from the students according to the actual cost);Accommodation: 7500RMB per year for a single room.Cost of Living: RMB 700~RMB 1,000

duration.text: The BDS in English at China Medical University is a 5 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 5555 USD/per year ￥ 40000 CNY/per year

materials.text: Documentary requirements1. Scanned copy of the passport (photo page, the latest exit/entrance record visa page, two blank visa pages).2. Senior high school transcripts and graduation diploma (Students expecting to graduate should provide an official letter stating the expected graduation date, and submit the graduation diploma if admitted), which should be the original documents or certified copies in Chinese or English (Applicants from India should also provide the transcripts from 12th semester).3. For the applicants of English-taught programs, Chinese language proficiency is not required when they apply, but the applicants must have HSK level 4 or above before internship. Applicants whose native/official language is not English should submit the IELTS /TOFEL result or other certificate to certify their English level. The result should be above 85(New TOFEL) or 6.0(IELTS).Chinese Proficiency Certificate (HSK score report, for the applicants of Chinese-taught programs only).4. Physical Examination Form.5. For applicants whose age is under 18 and parents are not resident in China, their parents must formally entrust a foreigner or Chinese resident in China as the guardian of the applicants and provide relevant entrusted materials.For the current applicants in China, the following documents are also required to submit in addition to the ones mentioned above:(1) residence permit page;(2) transfer certificate/no objection certificate/graduation certificate;(3) transcripts from the previous school;(4) registration form of temporary residence for Visitors from Overseas;(5) foreigner Physical Examination Form.6. If the applicant was originally a Chinese citizen but later joined a foreign nationality, he/she must provide (1) a certificate of withdrawal of Chinese nationality; (2) a certificate of cancellation of Chinese household registration; (3) a certificate of joining a foreign nationality; and (4) a record of entry and exit from the country during the period from April 30, 2020 to April 30, 2024.7. For applicants who were born in a foreign country and have acquired foreign nationality, if both or one of the parents are Chinese citizens, the applicant must provide (1) the applicant's birth certificate; (2) proof of nationality of the applicant's parents (the Chinese citizen side); and (3) the applicant's entry and exit records between April 30, 2020 and April 30, 2024.8. Physical examination report 9. certificate of no crime.Uptate time : 2025-03-11

requirements.text: (1) Aged 18-25(2) Senior-high-school graduates(3) Examination results in physics, chemistry and biology should be better than average.
